subject: Animation
title: New Zealand: Weta's Animation Empire
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on New Zealand: Weta's Animation Empire.

hook.text: New Zealand's Weta Digital became a global animation powerhouse through its work on The Lord of the Rings.

buildup.text: Weta created Gollum, the first fully convincing CGI character in a live-action film, using motion capture.

discovery.text: Gollum proved that computer animation could create characters as emotionally complex as any human performance.

twist.text: Weta later animated the Na'vi for Avatar, creating the highest-grossing film in history from tiny New Zealand.

climax.text: A small country at the bottom of the world builds the animation technology that powers Hollywood blockbusters.

punchline.text: New Zealand animates Hollywood's biggest films from the edge of the world.

quiz.question: What breakthrough did New Zealand's Weta Digital achieve?
options: They created the first stop-motion feature film
They created Gollum, the first fully convincing CGI character in a live-action film
